review_notes: Reviewed the complete target file and compared its pool decoding and conditional-pool machinery with the imported source definitions. In particular, `decodePool` specializes the pool enumeration inverse, `actualPool` exposes the conditional finset as a prefix-indexed stage pool, and `nextPrefixDecoder` applies the existing `appendCode` operation to a supplied prior-word map. These provide stage-specific names and interfaces rather than an evidenced competing concept; the file also has downstream uses of them. I found no justified finding under this rubric.
